subject: Beacon Health: intermittent streaming silence and 504 spikes
messages:
From: Tony Nguyen <tony.nguyen@beaconhealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: live inference - streaming frequently drops (region us-west)

Hi Kimberly,

We're seeing frequent outages in our live summaries pipeline starting yesterday afternoon (US-West). The behavior is: responses begin streaming, then after 10-30s the client gets a silent period of 20-60s, sometimes resulting in a 504 from our edge. This is reproducible across multiple sessions and different users. Error rate on our side spiked from ~0.2% to 6% during the window.

Attached is a short partial_response_trace.txt captured from our browser showing chunked responses with long gaps. We'll forward any server-side logs if useful. This is impacting care team workflows — can we get something on this urgently?

Severity: P1 for us.

Thanks,
Tony Nguyen
Platform Ops — Beacon Health

Date: 2026-08-30T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: live inference - streaming frequently drops (region us-west)

Kimberly / team — acknowledging. Initial triage notes:
- Beacon trace shows the server sending chunked frames consistently, but the client observes long intervals with no bytes. That suggests buffering or stall either at our ingress (load balancer / proxy) or intermediate CDN/proxy on Beacon's side.
- No obvious model OOMs or runtime stalls in the first pass. CPU/GPU utilization on the serving pool remained nominal in the window.

Immediate plan:
1) Ask Beacon if they are applying any intermediate proxies or WAFs for streaming requests.
2) We'll pull edge and proxy logs for US-WEST for the timeframe (start: 2026-08-29T16:00 UTC).
3) Engineer-in-loop: Dev will run a packet-level pcap capture and check for TCP zero window or TLS renegotiation. Marcus will check proxy keepalive and chunked encoding path.

I'll sync back in 60–90 minutes.

-Rishi
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T10:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: live inference - streaming frequently drops (region us-west)

Quick update after the first wave of captures: attaching a consolidated logs.zip with edge-proxy logs, nginx front-door access logs, and a short pcap (pcap_capture.pcap). Findings so far:
- Proxy (nginx front door) shows a pattern where the upstream connection is kept open and last-byte timestamps are delayed ~25-45s for a subset of responses. Upstream (runtime) is still sending bytes (confirmed via internal loopback).
- There are repeated TCP retransmits in the pcap that correlate to the silent gaps; client-side retransmits then coincide with an HTTP 504 at the edge.
- Preliminary hypothesis: intermittent kernel-level TCP buffer exhaustion on the front-door host (observed zero-window events) combined with our keepalive/idle timeouts leads to chunk flushes being delayed and then the proxy returning 504 after its timeout.

Actionable next steps I've kicked off:
- Marcus: increasing proxy TCP buffer sizes and adjusting proxy proxy_read_timeout to 90s in a canary in us-west-2a.
- Ops runbook: I've created SUP-4821 and attached the initial artifacts.

Attachments: logs.zip (1.1MB), pcap_capture.pcap (320KB)

- Dev
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: ESCALATION: Beacon Health streaming blackouts — exec sync

Marissa / Vivek — looped you both in because Beacon has declared this P1: their internal workflows are materially impacted and error rate climbed to ~6% in the peak window. Rishi / Dev have run initial triage and found strong signals pointing at intermittent zero-window/TCP buffer exhaustion at our front-door proxy which produces long chunking stalls and client-visible 504s. Marcus has canaried a configuration change (increased TCP buffer + proxy_read_timeout) but Beacon reports the issue persists at a lower frequency.

Why exec attention:
- Customer is an active paid pilot with a potential expansion (deal BH-2026-Q3). Prolonged disruption risks renewal/expansion.
- The behavior affects live streaming only; if it becomes more widespread it could affect other customers in us-west.

Immediate asks for leadership:
1) Approve priority SRE war room and extended on-call coverage for the next 24–48 hours. Estimated burn: 6–8 engineer-hours.
2) Approve an incident credit & notification (if we confirm service-level impact beyond 30 minutes during business hours).
3) Help coordinate an exec-to-exec line with Beacon (Marissa, can you join a short sync with Beacon leadership?)

What we are doing now:
- Canaries in us-west-2a/b to roll proxy tuning.
- Packet captures and server-side tracing enabled for all front-door hosts in the target AZs.
- Postmortem template and customer comms draft are ready; will refine once RCA is confirmed.

Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
